buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. The period of contract shall be for a maximum of 03 years (initially for 01 year) from the st date of award of the contract, extendable on yearly basis after expiry of the 1 year. The t ender value for the entire 03 years of contract will be specified in the bid document. The ex tension will be done subject to the condition that the performance of the Service Provider is satisfactory, and both parties are mutually agreed in writing with existing terms & conditio ns. 2. The EMD shall be of the value of 2% of the contract value, where it is applicable, and eP BG shall be 5% of the contract value with a validity of 60 days beyond the date of terminati on of the contract. 3. The Service Provider/Bidder shall not be under liquidation, court receivership, or similar proceedings, and should not be bankrupt. The Service Provider/Bidder is to upload an under taking to this effect with the bid (i.e., not more than one month old from the date of publica tion of the tender). 4. The bidder must have experience for at least 03 years (minimum) to be indicated in the st bid document (ending on 31 March prior to the bid opening) of providing similar types of s ervices to any Central/State Govt. Organization/PSU/Public Listed Company. Copies of relev ant contracts/award orders are to be uploaded along with the bid in support of having provi ded services during at least 03 financial years. 5. The bidder must have successfully executed/completed similar services over the last thr ee financial years, i.e., the current financial year and the last three financial years (ending on 31st March prior to the bid opening):- a) Three similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal to4 0% (forty percent) of the estimated cost; or b) Two similar completed services costing not less than the amount equal to 50% (fifty pe rcent) of the estimated cost; or c) One similar completed service costing not less than the amount equal to8 0% (eighty p ercent) of the estimated cost. 6. The Bidder/Service Provider must have a registered office in the State of Consignee's Loc ation. If the Bidder/Service Provider does not have a registered office in the said State/locat ion at the time of submission of the bid, the successful bidder shall establish one within 30 days from the date of award of the contract. Payment shall be released only upon submissi on of documentary evidence confirming the establishment and functional status of the regi stered office. Documentary Evidence of address shall be: Electricity Bill/ Water or MC Tax bill/ESI Registration document/EPF registration document/G ST Registration document clearly mentioning the address within Tricity, Chandigarh/ Regist ered Proprietorship/ Registered Partnership/ registered Rent Agreement in the name of the Service Provider/Bidder clearly mentioning the address to be submitted as proof). 7. The Service Provider/Bidder should not have been blacklisted/prosecuted by any Central/ State Government/Union Territories /Department /Offices /Statutory Organizations/Researc h Institution/Autonomous Organizations/any court of law. The Service Provider must furnish latest/valid affidavit (not more than one month prior to d ate of floating of tender) on non-judicial stamp paper duly attested by the Executive Magist rate/Notary regarding non-blacklisting/non-prosecution of the Service Provider as per Perfor

ma given below: AFFIDAVIT I/We (Name) Service Provider/partner/sole proprietor strike out which is not applicable) of (firm) do hereby solemnly affirm and declare that the i ndividual/firm/company is not blacklisted/prosecuted by any Central/State Govt./Union Terri tories/Departments/Officers/Statutory Bodies/Autonomous Organizations/Research Institutions/any court of law. Place: __________________ Date: __________________ DEPONENT VERIFICATION Verified that the contents of the above affidavit are true and correct to the best of my/our k nowledge and belief. No part of it is false and nothing has been kept concealed there from. Place: __________________ Date: __________________ DEPONENT (Affidavit not one month old from date of bid) 8. The buyer shall specify in the bid documents to the bidder that existing skilled/experienc ed manpower working under his/her control would continue with new service provider after the award of the contract and they will not be replaced without the consent of Head of Insti tute. The list will be supplied to the service provider after the award of the contract. 9. The Service Provider shall engage one contact person for co-ordination of day-to-day act ivities, the manpower, and to coordinate with the department. He should be able to maintai n and upkeep all the records related to the job. 10. Seeking any deposits or security amounts from the deployed resource or any other for m of monetary acceptance by the service provider is strictly prohibited. If any such complai nt is received, the incident will be raised on GeM Portal for suitable action against the Servi ce Provider, as per the incident Management policy of GeM. In addition, the department ma y separately initiate suitable penal action and blacklist the Service Provider as per the Black listing policy of UT Chandigarh Administration, ‘Policy on Blacklisting, 2009’. 11. The Service Provider shall pay wages to the outsourced employees by the due date i.e., on or before 07 of every month and then raise a bill for reimbursement with due evidence of salary and statutory dues payment in the form of a Utilization Certificate duly verified co nfirming that all statutory compliances have been complied with. 12. In case of any violation of any terms & conditions of the contract, the Service Provider i s liable to be blacklisted as per Blacklisting policy of UT Chandigarh Administration, ‘Policy on Blacklisting, 2009 dated the 27th February 2009.’ 13. Any short payment and/or nonpayment of wages/salary, statutory contributions in resp

ect of service persons during the course of the contract shall be made good by the Service Provider within 7 days of written notice by the Department, failing which the Department re serves its right to deduct any such amount equivalent to such short payment from the paya bles to the agency or Security Deposit/EMD and may cancel the contract, blacklist the Servi ce Provider etc. 14. The Service Provider shall keep the department indemnified against all penalties, claim s and liabilities arising out of applicability and/or violation of such Act, laws or Regulations etc. 15. If at any stage during the period of the contract, it is observed by the department or by its authorized representative(s) that the services rendered by the Service Provider are not t o the satisfaction of the Department or any terms of the contract are violated, the Departm ent will issue one written notice for rectifying the default in 5 working days and thereafter if the default is not rectified the Department will immediately terminate the contract with im mediate effect without any further notice or compensation thereof and shall blacklist the S ervice Provider as per Blacklisting Policy of UT Chandigarh Administration, ‘Policy on Blackli th sting, 2009 dated the 27 February 2009.’ 16. Any amount due and recoverable from the Service Provider on account of salary/wages (minimum wage), insurance, PF, ESI etc.) and taxes, will be recoverable as arrears of land r evenue. 17. In case any situation arises, where re-allotment of a contract is required, the re-allotme nt will be done at the risk and cost of original allottee. In case of any deficiency, the balanc e/deficient amount will be recoverable from the original allottee as arrears of land revenue. 18. If the Service Provider fails/delays in performance of any of the obligations under the C ontract/violates any of the provisions of the Contract/commits breach of any of the terms a nd conditions of the Department may at any time, without prejudice to any other right of ac tion/remedy, may blacklist the Service provider under the Blacklisting policy of UT Chandig th arh Administration, ‘Policy on Blacklisting, 2009 dated the 27 February 2009. 19. The bidder shall submit a duly signed Integrity Pact (Integrated Pact) as pre scribed on the GeM Portal and comply with its provisions regarding prevention of corruption, fair bidding, non-cartelization, disclosure of intermediary payments a nd previous transgressions. Any violation shall attract disqualification and action as per the GeM Incident Management Policy. 20. The Service Charges shall be fixed as quoted/accepted in the initial GeM bid a nd shall remain unchanged during the entire contract period, including any exten sion. However, the rates of minimum wages/DA applicable to the outsourced ma npower shall be payable as revised from time to time by the Chandigarh Adminis tration/competent authority, as applicable. 21. All other terms & conditions will also be automatically applicable as standard "Terms & Conditions" which is reflecting on GeM Portal at the time of floating of tender. 22. The bidder will upload an undertaking to the fact that all terms and conditions mention ed in the bid document are acceptable to him.
